name: StraboMicro2 v2.0.50
notes:
## StraboMicro2 v2.0.50

### New Features
- PDF report micrograph images capped at 2000 px on the long side (shared imageExport.renderPdfImage; rendered at full size then shrunk, so spots and labels keep their proportions)

### Bug Fixes
- Renderer out of memory after many micrograph views (Sentry ELECTRON-2M, v2.0.49, macOS, 2026-10-06: heap limit 3.7 GB after ~235 views in one session). Every tiles Map the viewer ever held stayed reachable through old render scopes kept by memoized callbacks, and each entry carried its tile's data URL plus the decoded image. Tiles and the thumbnail no longer store the data URL (it lives only in img.src, which releaseImage drops), and cleanupTileMemory empties the released Map. Measured with Claire's 40-micrograph project, heap after GC over 50 views: 98 -> 241 MB before, 97 -> 107 MB after
- Trace Scale Bar: limits widened to 0.0001x-1000x (were 0.01x-10x) and never silent: outside them a warning under the inputs says the scale the length and unit give and asks to check them. Found in Jason's check of the loop fix: a 10x overlay on PF-5 (23336 px/cm) at 11 um came to 0.009x and was held at 0.01x without a word, so changing the length seemed to do nothing. The Scale readout shows 2 significant digits under 0.01x (was 0.00x). test:trace-scale-bar 14
- Trace Scale Bar and Drag no longer loops: the traced line is measured against the child's scale when it was drawn, not the scale it leads to. The two placement effects fed each other (new scale -> new measured pixels -> new scale), so after entering a length the scale ran to the 0.01/10 limit or React stopped it with 'Maximum update depth exceeded' (Sentry 7774408598, v2.0.49, macOS, 2026-10-05; there since the method was added in e9a4bb1). Math moved to src/utils/traceScaleBar.ts (the old three-step conversion reduces to line length / scale); the scale effect leaves the transform alone when the scale is unchanged. npm run test:trace-scale-bar 9 (incl. a simulation of the two effects: settles at once now; the old way runs away)
- An .smz export whose file cannot be opened (folder gone, no permission) now says Export Failed instead of hanging on 'Exporting...' forever (found by the e2e tests): the write stream's error fired before any listener was attached (logged as Unhandled) and its close never came. The file is opened before any work starts, and one promise tracks it to the end
- Restoring the saved session sets a missing micrograph imagePath to the micrograph id (as loading does), so a damaged stored session can no longer show "No micrograph loaded"
- Debug > Simulate Deep Link from Clipboard awaits clipboard.readText(), which returns a Promise since Electron 44
- Save project.json and StraboTools image overwrites atomically (temp file, flush, rename), so a crash mid-write can no longer leave a truncated file; shared electron/atomicFile.js also hosts the Windows lock retry used by rotate
- Keep login tokens unless the server rejects the refresh token (401); retry network and server errors, and report a connection problem instead of a login prompt
- Compare project data without regard to key order (shared deepEqual), so version history no longer flags unchanged items as modified
- PDF report: page numbers are fixed elements, so a nearly full page no longer pushes its number onto an extra blank page
- Associated files: never reuse a same-name file with different content, and never delete a file other entries still use

name: StraboMicro2 v2.0.46
notes:
## StraboMicro2 v2.0.46

### Important
- **macOS 13 (Ventura) or newer is now required.** Macs on older macOS versions will stay on v2.0.44 and will be told why when checking for updates.

### Improvements
- Updated the app's underlying platform (Electron 44) for security and compatibility, including fixes for image-library vulnerabilities
- File dialogs remember the last folder you used for images, files, and projects
- The macOS installer window displays correctly on macOS 26 (Tahoe)
- Grain detection reports a clear error if its analysis worker fails to start

### Known Issues
- Linux: opening a project by double-clicking an .smz file does not work in this version. Start StraboMicro first, then use File > Open Local Project (.smz).

### Note
- A few interface preferences (dismissed startup message, two panel expand/collapse states) reset once after this update.
